Create multiple issues efficiently

Source: R/batch.R
od_batch_create_issues.Rd

Creates multiple issues in batch, optionally reporting progress. Each issue spec should be a list with title (required), and optional description, fields, and iteration_ids. Uses od_create_issue() internally.

Usage

od_batch_create_issues(issues, progress = TRUE, conn = NULL)

Arguments

issues

list|tibble List of issue specs, or a tibble with title column and optional description, fields, iteration_ids columns. Each row/element should be a list with at least title.

progress

logical If TRUE (default), report progress. Default: TRUE.

conn

list Connection list from od_get_config() / od_connection(). Default: NULL.

Value

list Named list with:

  • created: List of created issue lists (each with id, number, title, etc.)

  • numbers: Numeric vector of created issue numbers

  • errors: List of errors encountered (empty if all succeeded)

  • summary: Character vector with status message

See also

Other batch: od_batch_link_issues_prs(), od_batch_transition_issues(), od_batch_update_issues()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Create multiple issues from a tibble
issues_to_create <- tibble::tibble(
  title = c("Issue 1", "Issue 2", "Issue 3"),
  description = c("Desc 1", "Desc 2", "Desc 3"),
  fields = list(
    list(Priority = "High"),
    list(Priority = "Normal"),
    list(Priority = "Low")
  )
)
result <- od_batch_create_issues(issues_to_create)
} # }
